Home.title: ICHEC 2026
Home.aboutSubtitle: An Open, Inclusive, and Future-Oriented HCI Community
Home.aboutBrief: Meet in Macau, connect research, design, and industry.
Home.aboutP1: The International Chinese Association of Computer Human Interaction (ICACHI) is delighted to announce that the International Conference on Human-Engaged Computing (ICHEC 2026) will be hosted by the City University of Macau and held at Wynn Macau, Macau, China, from November 23 to 26, 2026. The conference theme is “Inclusivity, Experience, Innovation”.
Home.aboutP2: ICHEC (formerly known as “Chinese CHI”) was initiated by ICACHI and has become a premier venue connecting HCI scholars, practitioners, and industry leaders worldwide. Since 2012, Chinese CHI has been successfully held in Paris, Toronto, Seoul, Silicon Valley, Guangzhou, Montreal, Xiamen, Bali, Shenzhen, and Singapore. The papers accepted at the conference in the past years have been published annually in the ACM Digital Library and are indexed by EI Compendex.
Home.aboutP3: The conference was officially renamed ICHEC in 2025 to reflect its broader inclusiveness and international participation. In 2026, we cordially invite leading scholars, researchers, and industry leaders from around the world to share their latest research progress and practical experiences, foster intellectual exchange and research collaboration, and explore the boundless possibilities that lie ahead in the future development of HCI.
Home.themeDescription: Bringing together diverse disciplines and cultural backgrounds, focusing on the social impact and ethical boundaries of human-AI collaboration, and strengthening mutual trust and co-creation in the wave of intelligence.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.b2: Double-blind review: remove author-identifying information from the paper and supplements.

topics.title: Topics
topics.b1: Preliminary findings, pilots, exploratory studies, and emerging research directions.
topics.b2: Design prototypes, case studies, methods, datasets, tools, or applied HCI practice.
topics.b3: Thought pieces and discussion-oriented work aligned with inclusivity, experience, and innovation.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.b2: Use the ACM template in single-column review format.
requirements.b3: The main text must not exceed 5,000 words in a single-column layout.
requirements.b4: Double-blind review: remove author-identifying information from the paper and supplements.

topics.title: Topics

requirements.b1: Artwork abstract: no more than four A4 PDF pages.

footer.aboutFull: ICHEC 2026 will be held in Macau SAR, China, continuing the spirit of Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) and focusing on how Artificial Intelligence and emerging technologies intertwine with human values, culture, and lived experiences. The conference covers the full spectrum of HCI topics, from technical innovation to critical inquiry, and from creative expression to deployable systems. We welcome researchers, designers, artists, and practitioners from around the globe to share their work and perspectives. We encourage human-centered, responsible AI and interactive technology practices, promoting the effective translation of research into social applications to shape a more inclusive and resilient future technology ecosystem.
